budget_resolution.per_refresh: 1 attempt/2-credit worst-case reservation follows existing one-fetch client and vendor cost, not an arbitrary cap; automatic retries0 is a deliberate narrower candidate than client default.
budget_resolution.daily_monthly: UNRESOLVED until owner supplies account plan, other-use allowance and desired operator limits. Require explicit positive approved values; fail closed if missing. Enforce daily refreshes<=daily_requests and2*daily_refreshes<=daily_credit_cap; monthly equivalent; caps<=verified plan/balance allocation less safety reserve.
budget_resolution.illustration_not_approval: At500 credits and no other usage/reserve, floor(500/2)=250 full-cost refreshes/month. This arithmetic is not an assigned account budget or recommended polling frequency.
budget_resolution.reservation: Reserve1 request and2 credits atomically before send. Count attempted sends conservatively even if response absent. Reconcile trustworthy last/remaining/used headers without refunding an uncertain attempt; reject mismatched scope/period/clock. Cross-process/restart limits need authenticated durable non-source counters or one-time owner grants; volatile memory alone cannot promise daily/monthly enforcement.
budget_resolution.rate_limit: 429 terminates this grant, records typed sanitized reason, does not silently retry. A later explicit Refresh needs a fresh grant/budget and respects approved cooldown. No new free quota-check routes are added.
